caption: The drawing depicts a single object positioned centrally on a blank, beige or off-white background. The object consists of a long, thin vertical pole that extends up from a wide, circular, flat base with a conical element rising from its center. Near the top of the pole, there is a rectangular tray that is seen almost at eye level, with two cylindrical containers placed on it, spaced apart. There is a hook-like extension rising upward in the middle from the tray. Below this tray, a semicircular support element is visible, reinforcing the connection between the tray and the pole. The entire object is rendered in shades of gray and black, creating a metallic or iron-like appearance, and the overall arrangement suggests a utilitarian design. The background features faint brown and yellow stains or marks across the otherwise plain surface.
title: Candlestand
